How is my window calculated?

Each week, Sommelle compares the time you slept with the time you spent in bed. As a rule, above 85%, the window grows by 15 minutes; below 80%, it shrinks by 15 minutes, without going under a safety floor. In between, it stays the same. Your rise time never changes.
What if a bad night comes back later?

An occasional bad night (stress, travel, life event) is normal and does not mean chronic insomnia is back:
• The next morning: keep your usual rise time, without sleeping in.
• During the day: skip naps so your evening sleep drive stays strong.
• At night: if sleep does not come, get out of bed for about twenty minutes without checking the clock.
• If hard nights last more than 5 days: return to a tighter sleep window for one to two weeks.
